source: curated by hand (2026-11-03, mcp-server.md §12.9) from the profile by tools/machine-profiler.py on windows, 2026-11-03 and the evidence listed
summary: Classic Buzz bass synth (acid flavoured): one oscillator (sine, saw, pulse, triangle, noise or an acid saw) into a resonant filter with an envelope, per track. For basses and acid lines in Buzz songs.
use_for: Squelchy acid and rolling bass lines with accent and slide.
quirks: Each track is its own monophonic voice with its own filter settings (8 at most).

It plays notes as written (no offset): its default patch dies in about 100 ms, too fast for analyze's pitch metric, but the profiler's harmonic sieve hears A2, A3 and A4 within 3 cents (U2 in depth, mcp-server.md §12.12).
Volume, Note length and Slide note are pattern columns, not set with param_set (in the repo's songs they are non-state track parameters).
Closed source: names and units come from its own descriptions and texts.
evidence: its parameter descriptions and value texts (machine_describe, as profiled)
ExternalMachines/source/buzztrax-buzzmachines/CyanPhase/DTMF/CyanPhase_DTMF-1_Demo.bmx — a repo song using it; its saved parameter table lists the track columns
profile (tools/machine-profiler.py, windows 2026-11-03) — −11 LUFS for a note, monophonic per track, no pitch heard
profile in depth (tools/machine-profiler.py, windows 2026-11-04) — the harmonic sieve hears A2, A3 and A4 as written (offset 0)

track Resonance.evidence: a peak at 4 kHz stands -3 → +18 dB over the spectrum an octave either side

track Envmod.evidence: the level falls half way to its held level in 45 ms → 15 ms

track Decay.evidence: the level falls half way in 85 ms → 65 ms (the default 45 ms) to the same held level

track Waveform.evidence: a choice: its texts say what it is; no role measured

track_parameters.name: Cutoff
track_parameters.how: Sets the filter's corner, from 0 to 100 percent; fully open is the default.
track_parameters.sound: Lower values close the filter and make the note duller.

track_parameters.name: Resonance
track_parameters.how: Sets the emphasis at the cutoff, from 0 to 100 percent.
track_parameters.sound: Higher values add a squelchy peak that gives the acid sound.

track_parameters.name: Envmod
track_parameters.how: Sets how far the envelope opens the filter on each note, from 0 to 100 percent.
track_parameters.sound: More makes each note start brighter and settle.

track_parameters.name: Decay
track_parameters.how: Sets how fast the filter envelope falls, from 0 to 100 percent.
track_parameters.sound: Longer decays keep the note brighter for longer.

track_parameters.name: Waveform
track_parameters.description: Sine, sawtooth, pulse, triangle, noise or the acid sawtooth.
track_parameters.how: Chooses the oscillator: sine, sawtooth, pulse, triangle, noise or the machine's special acid sawtooth.
track_parameters.sound: Sine is pure, saw buzzy, pulse hollow, triangle soft, noise unpitched; the last is the classic acid saw.
